workstreams.title: Community mobilisation and operation
workstreams.summary: Builds, broadens and sustains the Strategic Communities of Practice themselves, from initial mobilisation through funded operating cycles and into business as usual.

workstreams.title: Operating model, governance and support
workstreams.summary: Creates and tests the common operating, governance, support and resource model that allows different communities to operate with proportionate institutional assurance and sustainable central support.

workstreams.title: Convenor and practice-project commissioning
workstreams.owner: King's Academy with the Innovation Committee
workstreams.summary: Runs the recurring route through which convenors and practice-based projects are selected, resourced, onboarded and renewed as the community portfolio grows and matures.

workstreams.title: Evidence, review and portfolio evolution
workstreams.owner: King's Academy with the Innovation Committee
workstreams.summary: Builds the evidence and review rhythm through which participation, practice development, institutional influence, resource demand and portfolio relevance inform support, expansion, refinement and the permanent settlement.
